findings.label: Özellik filter is a silent no-op until the backend ships
findings.detail: Until the backend supports /arama ozellikler=, selecting an özellik shows a chip and an active filter button but the results are unfiltered. Release the app with or after the backend change, or accept the interim behavior.

findings.label: Unrelated Plus-marker changes in the same working tree
findings.detail: lib/data/api.dart also has isPlus/parsePlusFlag hunks from the parallel map-plus-marker task, and place_flags.dart, app_theme.dart and the generated plugin files changed too. When committing, stage this feature separately, with hunk-level staging for api.dart.
